ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

22. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
